candidate_universal_obligation: For every state reached after R33 fixpoint that is nonterminal and non-affine, either an independently certified single-literal RUP strengthening exists or an independently replayable subsumption-aware exact-BVE step exists that strictly decreases CLV.

falsification_contract.COUNTEREXAMPLE: A reachable stalled non-affine state has no single-literal RUP proposal and no strict-descending R42 SA-BVE candidate, or any admitted step fails certificate/reconstruction/progress.
falsification_contract.FINITE_PASS: No such counterexample is found in the preregistered adversarial domain; this does not establish the universal obligation.

required_checks: Every admitted RUP has independent UP-conflict certificate.
Every admitted SA-BVE has independent_sa_bve_replay PASS.
Every admitted SA-BVE strictly decreases CLV.
Every SAT terminal returned by the W scheduler reconstructs to a model of the original formula.
Any residual emits exact formula/hash/CLV and door-scan ledgers for Y forensics.
